thread:
kira: quick thread  re: private onboarding options. we need a pattern that supports control-plane separation, auditable rollbacks, and clear egress billing. options: outbound agent in customer VPC, regional relay, or transit-bridge. thoughts?

tom: agent = best for audit & source-ip preservation. keep agent minimal (outbound TLS only). downside = customer infra burden + harder billing.

eli: relay = easiest for self-serve and central metrics. downside = more central blast radius and lost src ip.

deploy-bot: scheduled: onboarding-spike/mini-agent. tests: heartbeat, registration, fallback-path. report will post on completion.

sara: practical concerns: 1) rollback: CP must flip routing atomically and record event. 2) certs: agent can accept customer CAs or CP short-lived certs. 3) partial routes: allow per-route preferences so low-risk traffic can go to relay during agent outage.

kira: example fallback headers proposal: `x-rw-path: agent|relay|bridge`, `x-rw-fallback-reason: heartbeat|manual|forced`, `x-rw-agent-ver: <ver>`. include these in logs and tracing.

tom: egress accounting: if agent-mode, require customers to supply egress-tag or route through a billable transit. otherwise default to relay and tag costs centrally. finance to define metering.

eli: rollout suggestion: default relay for self-serve, agent-mode opt-in for enterprise with support. spike to build tiny agent that registers with one-time token, sends heartbeat, exposes /health. measure: onboarding time, fallback frequency, support tickets.

kira: action items: eli -> telemetry metrics + trace headers (ETA Thu). tom -> minimal agent bootstrap spec (ETA Wed). sara -> draft rollback audit event schema (ETA Fri). reconvene after spike.

eli: taking metrics.

kira: thanks all :thumbsup:
